syndication_note: Review counts are NOT one uniform syndicated number, but the large mass-retail counts look Bazaarvoice-syndicated: Home Depot 4.2/13,209, Lowe's 4.2/'over 12,000', Walmart 4.3/9,746, Grand Appliance ~7,556 — clustered in the same 7.5k-13k band, consistent with GE's Bazaarvoice network pooling reviews across the laundry-center family with retailer-specific inclusion rules. Best Buy is the outlier at 4.2/1,385 (electric) and 4.1/193 (gas) — an order of magnitude smaller and differentiated by model, suggesting a native or much narrower pool. Because every product-page fetch was egress-blocked, 'originally posted on...' attribution lines could not be checked.
blocked_sites: NOTE: blocking is environment-level (egress proxy denies retail domains generally), not retailer bot-detection; remaining retailers were covered via snippets only
